title: Freemax M1-D Mesh Coil 0.15ohm - 3 Pack
description: The Freemax M Mesh Coil are ideal for use with Freemax’s superb MPro tank series, which excel when paired with the Freemax Maxus 200W mods. These 0.15Ohm - M1-D mesh coils (50-80W, best 70W) boast FMCoilTech 5.0 technology, utilising Mesh Kanthal to elevate your vapour and flavour production to new heights. Compatible with the FreeMax M Pro 3 Tank, FreeMax M Pro 2 Tank and FreeMax M Pro Tank.
